A1.justification: Both PDFs describe ChunkKV and provide readable main text, equations, figures, tables, and appendices. Retained material can be matched across v4's additions and renumbering.

before.justification: V3 reports original benchmark evaluations, efficiency measurements, and ablations in Section 4 and Appendices A–B.

after.justification: V4 retains these empirical results and adds hybrid-layer, Palu, and longer-context efficiency comparisons.

M1.justification: The main ChunkKV and index-reuse algorithms remain unchanged. Section 4.6 adds an experimental hybrid variant applying ChunkKV to the first 16 LLaMA-3-8B layers and SnapKV to the final 16, a limited procedural adaptation.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate LongBench English/Chinese tasks, NIAH, GSM8K including many-shot prompting, and JailbreakV. New comparisons reuse this coverage; the longer efficiency input extends experimental settings.

E2.justification: V4 adds Palu at 50% and 70% ratios (Table 24), the hybrid comparator (Table 12), and SnapKV to the total-latency/throughput comparison (Table 26). StreamingLLM and SnapKV already appeared in v3's TTFT/TPOT comparison.

E3.justification: New experiments specify the 16/16-layer hybrid at 10% cache retention, Palu comparison budgets, and a 16,384-input/1,024-output efficiency setting. Existing benchmark protocols and the A40, batch-size-one, Flash Attention 2 efficiency setup remain unchanged.

E4.justification: Section 4.6 adds a depth ablation testing token-level compression in upper layers against uniform chunk compression, with task-category results in Table 12. Existing chunk-size, index-reuse, and attention-preservation analyses are retained.

E5.justification: V4 newly characterizes results as consistent for fixed model, prompt, and temperature, using this to deem significance reporting inapplicable (checklist item 7). Three-run benchmark means and ten-run efficiency means remain unchanged; no error bars or statistical tests are added.

E6.justification: V4 adds a hybrid LongBench average of 39.80 versus ChunkKV's 40.51 at 10% retention, Palu averages of 22.48/28.84 at its 50%/70% settings, and 16k efficiency measurements (Tables 12, 24, 26). Earlier results are retained; these additions do not establish same-setting performance improvements over v3.

T1.justification: The memory formula, index-reuse complexity argument, and Appendix C's definitions, distinguishability conditions, lemma, theorem, and proof are retained. Typesetting and pagination changes do not alter the mathematics.

C1.justification: The abstract, contribution statements, and conclusion retain the same semantic-preservation and layer-reuse claims, including the 8.7% precision and 26.5% throughput figures. New experiments do not redefine the central contribution.

C2.justification: V4 adds task-dependent interpretations of the hybrid results and attributes Palu's weaker performance to distribution mismatch. Appendix I expands the fixed-chunk limitation to fidelity-critical legal/biomedical applications and trade-offs between local retrieval and global understanding.

D1.justification: V4's abstract adds a code-access hyperlink to NVIDIA/kvpress; v3 only promised future code availability. The new hybrid's layer assignment is documented, while existing implementation pseudocode, optimizations, hardware, prompts, and dataset statistics are retained.

R1.justification: V4 adds references including Palu, OracleKV, LongGenBench, and AnTKV, briefly expands Appendix D, and adds positioning against a method described as training-based in Appendix B.7. The established related-work narrative remains largely unchanged.

P1.justification: V4 adds Section 4.6, a Palu appendix subsection, acknowledgements, and a NeurIPS checklist, expands the limitations prose, and updates the publication footer. Most existing paragraphs and the overall organization are retained.

P2.justification: V4 adds Tables 12, 24, and 26 for the hybrid, Palu, and expanded efficiency comparisons. Existing figures and tables remain, with renumbering, adjusted emphasis, page reflow, and relocation of some appendix tables.

improvement.justification: The added depth ablation, longer-context efficiency evidence, code link, and concrete applicability limits modestly improve validation and accessibility over v3. Reporting weaknesses limit the gain: Table 12's new SnapKV category summaries do not reconcile with retained detailed results in Table 17, and Palu's OOD explanation lacks a documented controlled test.
